🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-ON, with breadth at 10/11 sectors positive and strength spanning cyclical stocks and Financials, including GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%) ABOVE TREND. Top-five leadership spans 3 sectors: neither narrow (2 or fewer) nor broad (4 or more); style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary leads (+3.45% 1W; +7.40% 1M), with GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%) ABOVE TREND. Materials (+2.88% 1W; +9.05% 1M) and Healthcare (+2.26% 1W; +10.22% 1M) follow, led by PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology is weakest (-4.05% 1W; -6.51% 1M), with GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND. Communication is nearly flat (+0.04% 1W; -1.22% 1M), while Energy is positive but trails (+0.41% 1W; +10.64% 1M); TTWO (1W: -6.64% | 1M: -6.61%) is BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

Top five: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND, RCL (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +13.77%) ABOVE TREND, GILD (1W: +9.38% | 1M: +15.72%) ABOVE TREND, and PPG (1W: +8.06% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: neither narrow nor broad (3 sectors represented).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom five: INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND, NOW (1W: -33.87% | 1M: -23.69%) BELOW TREND, GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -9.14% | 1M: -24.46%) BELOW TREND, and BA (1W: -8.92% | 1M: -10.78%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Technology, with notable Industrial weakness in CAT and BA.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves include GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND. TMUS (1W: +6.76% | 1M: -3.27%) is in RECOVERY; AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION, signaling a transitional split in key-stock trends.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Weak, with sector returns of -4.05% 1W and -6.51% 1M; constituent-level positive counts are not provided. GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) and META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) are BELOW TREND, while AAPL (1W: -0.89% | 1M: +4.33%) and MSFT (1W: -0.50% | 1M: +1.78%) are in CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Positive, with sector returns of +0.96% 1W and +4.15% 1M; constituent-level positive counts are not provided. JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%), V (1W: +1.39% | 1M: +14.93%), and MA (1W: +2.31% | 1M: +16.18%) are all ABOVE TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Strong, with sector returns of +2.26% 1W and +10.22% 1M; constituent-level positive counts are not provided. LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%), JNJ (1W: +3.56% | 1M: +5.62%), and PFE (1W: +1.63% | 1M: +8.53%) are ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -2.66% | 1M: +11.44%) is in CORRECTION.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor exposure aligned with cross-sector strength, while remaining selective given Technology weakness and mixed key-stock trends. Style mixed / no clear leadership; monitor GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND, and reduce exposure to persistent laggards such as INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND, conditional on follow-through after its share-repurchase headline; LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND, monitor whether momentum holds despite softer EPS guidance news. BEARISH: GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND and INTC (1W: -24.38% | 1M: -45.20%) BELOW TREND, at risk if weakness persists.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary (+3.45% 1W; +7.40% 1M), Materials (+2.88% 1W; +9.05% 1M), and Healthcare (+2.26% 1W; +10.22% 1M), all positive on the sector-return measure. BEARISH: Technology (-4.05% 1W; -6.51% 1M) remains the clear laggard; Communication is mixed (+0.04% 1W; -1.22% 1M).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Absolute price levels are not included in the data; monitor prior-week highs and lows instead. NVDA (1W: -3.00% | 1M: -11.36%) BELOW TREND and GOOGL (1W: -12.61% | 1M: -17.27%) BELOW TREND need stabilization to ease downside risk, while GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND and JPM (1W: +1.65% | 1M: +1.66%) ABOVE TREND need to hold recent gains to confirm continuation.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
GM (+75): share-repurchase catalyst; GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND confirms the positive price response, though separate privacy-settlement news is a risk. GD (+78): raised full-year guidance after a quarterly beat; GD (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +12.53%) ABOVE TREND confirms the news. CRH (+75): resilient growth and a repurchase plan; CRH (1W: +6.97% | 1M: +11.15%) ABOVE TREND confirms the positive catalyst.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
META (-38): credit-rating outlook downgraded; META (1W: -4.30% | 1M: -15.28%) BELOW TREND confirms the negative signal. LLY (-35): higher sales but lower EPS guidance; LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) ABOVE TREND diverges from the negative headline. GM (-40): driver-data privacy settlement; GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) ABOVE TREND diverges, while the separate positive repurchase catalyst supports the price.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON, with 10/11 sectors positive; style mixed / no clear leadership, and top-five leadership spans 3 sectors. GM (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +10.20%) and LLY (1W: +11.31% | 1M: +23.28%) are showing relative strength, both ABOVE TREND. Monitor the divergence between broad positive sector breadth and Technology weakness, alongside LLY’s strong price action despite lower EPS guidance.
